abstract: The aim of this study was to evaluate the diagnostic and prognostic values of serum angiogenin concentration in cases with gestational trophoblastic diseases (GTDs). Seventy-two patients with GTDs and 20 first trimester healthy pregnant women (controls) participated in this study. According to the WHO scoring system, GTDs were subgrouped into 24 hydatiform mole spontaneous regression (HMSR), 18 postmolar gestational trophoblastic tumors of high risk (PMHR), 16 low-risk choriocarcinoma, and 14 high-risk choriocarcinoma. Before treatment, a blood sample from each case was assayed for human chorionic gonadotrophin , subunit (hCGb) by radioimmunoassay and angiogenin by enzyme immunoassay. Follow-up hCGb and angiogenin assays were carried out for 1 year after treatment. Pretreatment of abnormal values of serum angiogenin (> 711 ng/ml, upper 95% confidence interval of controls) was encountered in 100% of PMHR cases compared to no single case of HMSR. Serum angiogenin levels in low- and high-risk cases with choriocarcinoma were significantly higher than in controls. Abnormal high values were encountered in 25% and 86% of cases, respectively. None of the low-risk cases exceeded 920 ng/ml, while 72% of high-risk cases exceeded this value. Serial angiogenin assays were correlated with disease progression and were positively correlated with serum hCGb (r = 0.75, p < 0.01). In conclusion, serum angiogenin may be a valuable marker of differential diagnosis of GTDs and its serial measurements are suggestive of remission and effective therapeutic intervention or disease progression.
abstract_ja: 目的：妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）患者における血清アンジオゲニン濃度の診断的・予後的価値を評価すること。方法：GTD患者72例と初期妊娠の健常妊婦20例（対照）を対象とした。WHOのスコアリングシステムに従い、GTDを奇胎自然消退24例、胞状奇胎後高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（PMHR）18例、低リスク絨毛癌16例、高リスク絨毛癌14例に分類した。治療前に、hCGβサブユニット（hCGb）をラジオイムノアッセイ、アンジオゲニンを酵素免疫測定法で測定した。治療後1年間にわたりhCGbとアンジオゲニンを追跡測定した。結果：治療前のアンジオゲニン異常高値（711 ng/ml超、対照の95%信頼区間上限）は、PMHR症例の100%に認められ、奇胎自然消退症例では1例も認められなかった。低リスクおよび高リスクの絨毛癌症例の血清アンジオゲニン値は対照より有意に高値であった。異常高値は、それぞれ25%および86%の症例で認められた。低リスク症例はいずれも920 ng/mlを超えなかったが、高リスク症例の72%は920 ng/mlを超えていた。連続測定したアンジオゲニン値は疾患進行と相関し、血清hCGb値と正の相関を示した（r = 0.75, p < 0.01）。結論：血清アンジオゲニンはGTDの鑑別診断に有用なマーカーとなりうる。また連続測定値は寛解や有効な治療介入、あるいは疾患進行を示唆する。
